notes.title: Summer with Mia The Translationing update
notes.content:
Hi, 

We are super excited to announce a big event for Summer with Mia called [b]The Translationing[/b]!
We have translated the game to the following languages:
[list]
[*] Bulgarian
[*] Czech
[*] Danish
[*] German
[*] Greek
[*] Spanish
[*] Finnish
[*] French
[*] Hungarian
[*] Indonesian
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Norwegian (Bokmål)
[*] Dutch
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese (Brazilian)
[*] Portuguese (all Portuguese varieties excluding Brazilian Portuguese)
[*] Russian
[*] Swedish
[*] Turkish
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Chinese (simplified)
[/list]

We have also given the Narrator a voice.

Other updates:
Updated UI
Modernized intro splash art
Other minor tweeks and bug fixes


We hope that you will enjoy this update. All our games on Steam will be getting this update soon.

Best regards,
Inceton Games Team

notes.title: Summer with Mia Season 1 Content Update
notes.content:
Hi,

Due to popular demand we have added the Gallery Room, Bonus Scenes and 50 Steam Achievements.

Gallery Room:
Here you can replay hot scenes that you unlock by playing the game.

Bonus Scenes:
We have added a total of 14 bonus scenes into the game. Some might be locked based on your NTR preferences. The Bonus Scenes Room becomes available once you complete the game.

Steam Achievements:
You can unlock up to 50 Achievements.

Best regards,
Inceton games team
